oplossingen.sub: Every hotel is different. That is why Lemnion offers a complete range of solutions, from grid congestion to sustainability. Choose where you want to start.
oplossingen.label: Keep reading
oplossingen.lead: Hotels face unique energy challenges. Lemnion tackles all of them, not with loose products but with an integrated system that grows with your hotel.
oplossingen.c1p: Gridlock on the power grid blocks expansion and new builds. Lemnion bypasses the queue with battery storage and smart control. Available immediately, without grid reinforcement.
oplossingen.c2p: Going gas-free without extra grid capacity seems impossible. With Lemnion you combine heat pumps and induction cooking with battery storage. That way you become more sustainable without getting stuck on the grid.
oplossingen.c3p: Between 17:00 and 21:00 consumption peaks. Exceeding your contracted capacity? Then sky-high penalties follow. Lemnion flattens peaks with battery storage and EMS.
oplossingen.c4p: What do you do with surplus solar power? Feeding it back to the grid is not always possible anymore and can cost money. Store it in your own battery and use it when you need it.
oplossingen.c5p: Want to get rid of your diesel generator? A Lemnion battery system delivers reliable backup power, without emissions, fuel costs or maintenance.
oplossingen.ctah: Ready to free your hotel from grid congestion?
oplossingen.ctap: Calculate in 1 minute what your hotel can save with its own energy system.
